papers.title_en: An Immersed Interface Method for Parabolic Interface Problems with Nonlinear Jump Conditions
papers.evidence: 针对抛物型界面问题的浸没界面方法，可作为两相流界面模拟的数值技术。
papers.tldr: 针对一维非线性抛物界面问题中的非线性跳跃条件 [u]_α=λu^+u^-，传统方法处理界面耦合较为困难，本文提出一种浸入界面有限差分法。该方法将Crank-Nicolson离散与s参数约化相结合，将非线性界面耦合转化为一个标量二次方程，显著简化数值求解；论文还对比了IIM-Newton与Newton-IIM两种迭代策略的适用性。数值实验验证了方法的精度与稳定性，为含非线性跳跃条件的界面问题提供了高效、鲁棒的数值求解途径。
papers.abstract_en: We develop an immersed interface finite difference method for a one-dimensional nonlinear parabolic interface problem with jump condition \[ [u]_α=λu^+u^-. \] The method combines a Crank--Nicolson immersed interface discretization with an \(s\)-parameter reduction of the nonlinear interface condition, thereby reducing the nonlinear coupling to a scalar quadratic equation. We also discuss two different viewpoints for combining Newton iteration with immersed interface discretization, namely the IIM--Newton and Newton--IIM formulations. Numerical experiments are presented to illustrate the behavior and accuracy of the method.
